turns.question: Which kind of customer call left people happiest in September 2026, and in what share of those calls?
turns.answer: Calls about the product left customers happiest in September 2026 (1 to 30 September): a positive-sentiment share of 75% (12 of 16 labelled calls), while delivery, pricing and returns calls had no positive calls. These are model-derived labels (gemini-3.5-flash, prompt v1). Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
